Jurus nyinyir mereka seperti "cari lewat Google Maps" juga taktik pr semu, mereka pakai appeal to emotion, tahu orang indon emosian semua. And I see it, a glorious clusterf**k, a massive success in mobilising netijen mahabenar who got trapped in aforementioned psychological tricks to burn the heretics.
